question: Does requiring Benchmark, Deployment, and Authority support for an AGI claim prevent Dossier winner overrides from amplifying one strategic route while preserving viable claims and strategic diversity?
requiredDiagnostics: profile and faction win shares by supported player count
Dossier eligibility, supported evidence, declaration, and winner override rates
Core Action and Program selection frequencies

selectionRule.candidatePreferred: Select the candidate only if it reduces AGI flood and four-player homogeneous-backend profile dominance without exceeding faction, seat, interaction, pairwise, or diversity bounds, while three- and five-player guards remain viable.
selectionRule.canonicalPreferred: Retain the two-of-three claim if requiring every evidence module eliminates the AGI path, makes Trust or infrastructure compulsory, or fails to improve the registered dominance signals.
selectionRule.interpretation: The one-lever result may select a candidate for human review. It does not establish human balance or promote the rule automatically.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Any selected threshold requires synchronized Dossier copy, player aids, browser behavior, tests, a fresh release candidate, and explicit user approval.

surfaceAudit.canonicalRulebook: no change; this is a simulation-only candidate
surfaceAudit.tests: existing Dossier threshold and claim-resolution coverage
